hero.title: Flying Bird
hero.p: A 3D remake of Flappy Bird focused on C++ gameplay architecture and cross-platform deployment.

img.desc: The banner for the Flying Bird project.

about.title: Technical Recreation
desc: Flying Bird is a personal study project designed to practice the Unreal Engine mobile pipeline.
The objective was to recreate classic mechanics using a full C++ backend.

points.1: Velocity Reset: Custom flight logic that normalizes vertical speed before each impulse for consistent jumps.
points.2: Procedural Loop: Spawner system managing the lifecycle and randomized Z-axis offsetting of obstacles.

points.1: Event-Driven: Usage of Dynamic Multicast Delegates to decouple gameplay logic from UI and Audio.
points.2: Data Persistence: Full C++ implementation of SaveGame for local high scores and settings.

points.1: Cross-Platform: Use of #if PLATFORM_ANDROID macros for dynamic UI injection.
points.2: Code-Driven UI: Widget hierarchy parented to C++ classes with programmatic Slate styling.

events.title: Event Architecture
events.desc: Usage of Dynamic Multicast Delegates in the GameState to decouple gameplay triggers (Score, Death, High Score) from the UI and audio systems, ensuring a clean and modular communication flow.
events.img_alt: Delegate System: Implementation of event broadcasting to maintain a clean communication flow between classes.
events.img1_desc: Delegate Declarations: C++ header definitions of the dynamic multicast delegates (Start, Countdown, Score, Pause, Dead) inside the GameState class.
events.img2_desc: Event Broadcasting: Implementation in the .cpp file showing the .Broadcast() calls for score updates, high scores, and player death.
events.img3_desc: UI Event Binding: Initialization inside NativeConstruct() binding GameState delegates via AddDynamic to update UI text elements seamlessly.

bird.title: Physics & Impulse
bird.desc: Flight logic handled via AddImpulse. The system dampens angular velocity and locks rotation to maintain stability during physics simulation.
bird.img_alt: Impulse Logic: A view of the impulse force parameters and the character setup in the editor.
bird.img1_desc: Blueprint Setup: View of the BP_Bird actor in the editor, highlighting the exposed ImpulseForce parameter in the Details panel.
bird.img2_desc: Impulse & Velocity Reset: C++ code showing the vertical velocity normalization prior to applying the physical impulse force.

collisions.title: Collision Management
collisions.desc: Optimization of custom collision channels to separate lethal meshes from scoring triggers, preventing false-positive overlaps and ensuring accurate interaction detection via C++ configuration and editor presets.
collisions.img_alt: Collision Filtering: Custom trace channels and object types configuration for accurate interaction detection.
collisions.img1_desc: Custom Trace Channels: Definition of dedicated game trace channels (BIRD, PIPE, SCORE) inside Flying_Bird.h.
collisions.img2_desc: C++ Constructor Setup: Side-by-side view of Bird.cpp and Pipes.cpp initializing object types and collision responses programmatically.
collisions.img3_desc: Editor Collision Presets: Combined editor panels showing physics blocking settings for pipe meshes, query-only setup for score triggers, and the bird character configuration.

spawner.title: Procedural Spawning
spawner.desc: Implementation of a tick-based generator managing obstacle lifecycles. It utilizes FFloatRange and random ranges to procedurally offset the vertical height of spawned pipes at regular time intervals.
spawner.img_alt: Procedural Spawner: Setup of the spawner properties and random generation logic.
spawner.img1_desc: Spawner Properties: Editor view of the BP_PipesSpawner actor exposing configurable properties like spawn delay and vertical bounds (Min/Max).
spawner.img2_desc: Randomized Spawn Logic: C++ implementation in PipesSpawner.cpp using FFloatRange to randomize the Z-axis offset during actor spawning.

input.title: Cross-Platform Input
input.desc: Unified mapping via Unreal's Enhanced Input system, allowing the exact same gameplay logic to seamlessly handle Android touch events and Windows keyboard/mouse clicks.
input.img_alt: Enhanced Input System: Configuration showing input actions, data assets, and mapping context for multi-platform support.
input.img1_desc: Enhanced Input Assets: Combined view showing the Input Mapping Context (IMC), Data Asset container, and individual Input Actions (Fly and Pause) configured for touch and keyboard.
input.img2_desc: C++ Input Binding: Implementation in BirdController.cpp handling action bindings and platform-specific conditional compilation macros.

ui.title: Logic-Driven & Cross-Platform UI
ui.desc: A sophisticated UI system where every Widget Blueprint is parented to a C++ class. It features platform-specific logic and programmatic styling to ensure performance and visual consistency.
ui.img_alt: Cross-Platform UI System: Code-driven widgets, preprocessor macros, and complete game loop interfaces.
ui.img1_desc: Android Platform Optimization: A C++ code snippet showing the use of preprocessor macros (#if PLATFORM_ANDROID) to conditionally inject and display the pause button only on mobile builds.
ui.img2_desc: C++ Parenting & Hierarchy: A view of the Widget Blueprint editor highlighting the C++ parent class and the organized hierarchy of interactive elements.
ui.img3_desc: Complete UI Ecosystem: A comprehensive look at the full game loop interface, combining the main menu, the minimalist gameplay HUD, and the death screen with score persistence.
